readings.title: The Lord's Prayer
paragraphs: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.
And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, forever and ever. Amen.

readings.title: Hail Mary
paragraphs: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

readings.title: Glory Be
paragraphs: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. We praise You and bless Your holy name.
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. May the glory of God shine upon us forever.

readings.title: Morning Prayer
paragraphs: Dear Lord, thank You for this new day. Help me to be kind, to be honest, and to do Your will in all things.
Bless my family and friends. Keep us safe and guide us in Your love. May Your light shine in our hearts today. Amen.

readings.title: Evening Prayer
paragraphs: Dear God, thank You for this day. Thank You for the love of my family and for all the good things You have given me.
Watch over us as we sleep. Keep us safe through the night. Help us to rest and wake ready to serve You. Amen.

readings.title: Prayer Before Meals
paragraphs: Bless us, O Lord, and bless these Your gifts, which we are about to receive from Your loving bounty. We thank You for this food and for the hands that prepared it.
Through Christ our Lord, we ask You to bless this meal and make us grateful for all You provide. May this food give us strength to serve You. Amen.

readings.title: Prayer After Meals
paragraphs: We give You thanks, almighty God, for all the blessings You have given us today. We are grateful for this food and for Your loving care.
May we always remember those who are in need. Help us to share what we have with others, and to live with grateful hearts. Amen.

readings.title: Guardian Angel Prayer
paragraphs: Angel of God, my guardian dear, to whom God's love commits me here. Ever this day be at my side, to light and guard, to rule and guide.
Protect me from all harm and danger. Help me to be good and to follow God's path. Stay close to me, my dear angel. Amen.

readings.title: Act of Contrition
paragraphs: My God, I am sorry for my sins with all my heart. In choosing to do wrong and failing to do good, I have sinned against You.
I firmly intend, with Your help, to do better and to avoid what leads me away from Your love. Have mercy on me and help me to grow. Amen.

readings.title: Prayer to St. Michael
paragraphs: Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle. Be our protection against all that is wicked and harmful in this world.
Help us to stand strong in faith and to trust in God's power. May God command His angels to guard us on every side. Amen.
